title: Geese for the Market
offer: The geese of Frosttorp are the fattest on the lakes. I want six for the market! Each goose takes a crate, and they honk all the way.

steps.load_say: Honk! Honk! Hold on to your hats, girls.
steps.say: Six geese, and not one escaped! The market will be loud today.

fact: Geese were kept on viking farms for eggs, feathers and down for pillows.
